title: US parcel carrier service guarantees (money-back guarantee) - default rule table
disclaimer: Carrier guarantees are suspended, reinstated and changed without notice. Re-check every source_url before filing, and edit this file (or pass --rules) when terms change.

default.reason: No rule matches this carrier/service; treated as NOT guaranteed.

FEDEX.holidays_note: Placeholder list of common US carrier holidays. Replace with the carrier's published holiday schedule. Service Guide (MBG policy B.5): shipments scheduled for delivery on a holiday are delivered the next business day and the commitment is extended by the length of the holiday.

calendar_adjustments.citation: FedEx Service Guide 2026, U.S. Terms, Money-back guarantee policy C.4: no refund if scheduled for the Wednesday before Thanksgiving and delivered within 90 minutes of the commitment.
FedEx Service Guide 2026, U.S. Terms, Money-back guarantee policy C.5: no refund if scheduled during the 7 calendar days before Christmas Day and delivered by end of day on the commitment date.

calendar_adjustments.services_note: FedEx listed First Overnight, Priority Overnight, 2Day A.M. (and Extra Hours variants) for commitments at 12 p.m. or earlier, and residential 1:30 p.m. commitments. Standard Overnight was NOT listed; this tool applies it to the whole fedex-us-time-definite rule when the commitment is 1:30 p.m. or earlier, which errs toward not flagging.
calendar_adjustments.citation: FedEx money-back guarantee page, 'Recent holiday delivery commitment times updates - Effective Sept. 9, 2026': commitment times extended by 90 minutes on Sept. 9 and 10, 2026.

calendar_adjustments.citation: DMM 604.9.5.5: no refund if a Priority Mail Express 1-Day item mailed Dec 22-25 was delivered or attempted within 2 business days of mailing. Business days here skip Sundays and the USPS holidays list.

rules.citation: FedEx MBG page: effective Feb. 12, 2026 the MBG applies to First Overnight, Priority Overnight, Standard Overnight, 2Day A.M. (+ Extra Hours contract variants); reinstated for packages shipped on or after Jan. 13, 2026. Service Guide 2026 MBG policy A: service failure = delivery 60 seconds or more after the commitment; D.3: request within 15 calendar days of the invoice date (15 days from ship date when paying by credit card, cash, check or money order).
rules.notes: Claim deadline uses invoice_date when the CSV has it, otherwise ship_date + 15 days (the earliest possible deadline, and exactly right for credit-card payers). The MBG is payer-only and one refund per package.

rules.citation: FedEx MBG page, 'Effective Dec. 1, 2025': MBG suspended for packages shipped on or after Dec. 1, 2025 for these services, until the Jan. 13, 2026 reinstatement.
rules.notes: Ship dates before Dec. 1, 2025 are not covered by any rule and default to not guaranteed; add a rule if you need to audit older shipments.

rules.citation: FedEx MBG page: 'the money-back guarantee for all other FedEx services will remain suspended until further notice.' Service Guide 2026: 'There are no delivery commitments for shipments on which the money-back guarantee is suspended.'
rules.notes: Listed explicitly so the output says 'suspended' rather than 'unknown service'.

rules.citation: FedEx MBG page: reinstated for these international services (all lanes, U.S. payors) with a ship date starting Feb. 12, 2026. Shipments delayed by regulatory changes are not eligible.
rules.notes: International claim terms are in the Service Guide's international section; this tool assumes the same 15-day window as domestic - UNVERIFIED for international, check before filing. Destination zone must be given as dest_tz.

commitment_adjustments.citation: ups.com/serviceguarantee: since Oct. 18, 2021, UPS Next Day Air to residential locations with a typical 10:30 AM commitment is extended to 12:00 PM for the guarantee. Applied when residential is true OR unknown (conservative).

rules.citation: ups.com/serviceguarantee: Service Guarantee currently active for Next Day Air Early, Next Day Air, Next Day Air Saver, 2nd Day Air A.M.; suspended for all other services. UPS Tariff/Terms (effective Apr. 17, 2026) sec. 54.1: on time = attempted before or within 60 seconds of the published time; notify UPS within 15 calendar days of the scheduled delivery date (or of UPS amending the delivery time, whichever is later); refund is transportation charges only, payer only. 54.2: 2nd Day Air A.M. residential deliveries are not guaranteed.
rules.notes: UPS counts a delivery ATTEMPT as on time; if your export has first_attempt it is used. Refund excludes fuel surcharge and other fees.

commitment_adjustments.citation: ups.com/serviceguarantee: 'Until further notice, the guaranteed delivery time for UPS Next Day Air Saver deliveries has been extended to end-of-day (11:59 p.m. on the guaranteed day of delivery).'

rules.citation: ups.com/serviceguarantee: Next Day Air Saver guarantee active, commitment extended to 11:59 p.m. on the guaranteed day. Tariff/Terms sec. 54.1: 15 calendar days from the scheduled delivery date to notify UPS.
ups.com/serviceguarantee lists these international services as active. Tariff/Terms sec. 54: guaranteed only where customs clearance is performed by UPS-designated brokerage offices.
rules.notes: Customs-clearance condition cannot be checked from a CSV; treat results as candidates only. Destination zone must be given as dest_tz.

rules.citation: ups.com/serviceguarantee: 'The UPS Service Guarantee remains suspended for all other UPS shipments and services not specified in the above sections, from any origin to any destination.' Tariff/Terms sec. 7: UPS may delay Ground and other non-guaranteed packages one additional day.
rules.notes: Listed explicitly so the output says 'suspended' rather than 'unknown service'.

rules.citation: DMM 604.9.5.1: USPS refunds postage if the item was not delivered, not attempted, or not made available for claim by the delivery date and time specified at mailing. Exhibit 9.2.1: Priority Mail Express refund requests no sooner than 2 days and no later than 30 days from the mailing date (30-60 days with an extra service). 9.5.5: no refund (other than for loss) for items to/from Alaska, Hawaii, Guam, American Samoa, CNMI, Palau, Marshall Islands, Micronesia.
rules.notes: date_only_commitment_time 18:00 is an ASSUMPTION (USPS labels normally carry a guaranteed time such as 6:00 PM; give promised as a datetime when you have it). Origin-side exclusions (mailed FROM AK/HI etc.) are not checked. With an extra service the window is 30-60 days; edit claim_window if that applies to you.

rules.citation: DMM 604.9.5 provides a delivery-failure postage refund only for Priority Mail Express. Other classes have delivery standards/estimates, not a money-back guarantee.
rules.notes: USPS complaints for non-Express mail are service requests, not refunds.
